When you say "I'm apart of this," (while not officially a correct statement), it actually means you are separated from the thing you mean to say you "are a part of."

"I'm a part of this" or "I'm not a part of this" or "I'm taking this thing apart" are correct uses.

"A Part" and "Apart" have two very different meanings.
